translations.web: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
translations.bsb: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
translations.kjv: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
translations.asv: He watereth the mountains from his chambers: The earth is filled with the fruit of thy works.
